expertiseSources.summary: Records the immutable upstream commit, operational lessons, portability changes, overlap boundaries, and security review for the migrated worktree orchestration workflow.
Distinguishes historical identities from runtime worker capabilities and defines privacy-preserving, bounded trace analysis.

exception.rationale: The workflow reduces checkout collisions, overlapping writes, and unvalidated integration. The revision propagates verified skill-loading routes and actual messaging capabilities before dispatch, batches explicit known recipients within host limits, and preserves ownership when a historical or non-messageable handle cannot accept a handoff. These controls require behavioral and maintainer review rather than a claimed average efficiency uplift.
